purpose: Check the revised steady-state measurement method before accepting a source change.
cohort: All 14 cases, Node and Bun, exactly 3 process pairs in each. Both arms use the main source.
noiseRule: Flag a case if its geometric mean candidate/baseline time is outside [0.95, 1.05], or all three paired ratios are below 0.97 or above 1.03. Keep every observation.
followup: A failure remains a measurement limit; do not weaken acceptance gates or repeat until a favorable result appears.
